scope: Read-only review of the fixed-native-k summary implementation and its two focused tests against the CP05 schema and strictly validated one-step collector outputs. No five-hour analysis has run; this receipt does not authorize scientific publication.
review_findings: The ledger forms paired FIX-minus-OLD entry and return differences, sums per-call internal deltas and between-call net deltas separately, and checks that both telescope to the endpoint over exactly 180 contiguous calls.
The selected hours map to actual process steps 1–180, 181–360, and 721–900; no term bridges the uncaptured 361–720 interval.
Arrays retain the level and point axes; there is no vertical or domain aggregation.
phase8−phase6 and phase12−phase11 channels are taken from the actual captured stage arrays. CP05 source assigns qci(:,:,1)=qc; the Q C mapping is consistent with that implementation.

QR sedimentation compares captured per-call native values with finite pairing; ordinary sum propagates any missing conditional call to NaN, which the CSV writes as null. The remaining internal sum also remains null in that case; no nansum or zero-fill is used.
The report labels between-call changes as net external operations, disclaims pure-transport causality, and states that the residual is not a closed column/domain water or energy budget.
nonblocking_hardening: Summary read_capture validates full status, mode, launch hash, time axes, dimensions and collector source hash, but does not itself assert cohort_receipt_sha256, capture_plan_sha256, schema_sha256, and source_generation_receipt_sha256 against the frozen expected values. The collector contract and its receipt already bind these; direct summary assertions would add defense in depth.

The focused tests cover the ledger telescoping identity and rejection of incomplete/misaligned inputs. They do not directly test the important conditional-sedimentation-null behavior, although the reviewed implementation correctly propagates NaN and emits null.
